Hi Amit / Sara —

Thanks again for the chat today. Quick recap + proposed next steps:

- Goal: schedule a technical deep-dive (30–45m) to cover integration patterns, data residency, and perf/cost tradeoffs.
- Participants we suggest: your engineering lead + infra/security (if available), Camila (AE), Aditya (Solutions Engineer), Marissa (CS).
- Important constraints: multi-region deployment (US + EU) and a primary preference for low-latency inference near EU customers.

To make scheduling easier across teams, we usually propose a rotating set of time slots (so we alternate times friendly to US/EU/APAC each week). Below are 6 initial options — please mark any that work and we can lock one in:

Week A (US-friendly)
- Tue Jun 22 — 10:00am PT / 1:00pm ET / 6:00pm BST
- Wed Jun 23 — 11:00am PT / 2:00pm ET / 7:00pm BST

Week B (EU-friendly)
- Thu Jun 24 — 3:00pm BST / 10:00am PT / 5:00pm IST
- Fri Jun 25 — 4:00pm BST / 11:00am PT / 6:00pm IST

Week C (APAC-friendly)
- Mon Jun 28 — 9:00am AEST / Sun Jun 27 7:00pm PT / Mon Jun 28 3:00am BST
- Tue Jun 29 — 11:00am AEST / Mon Jun 28 9:00pm PT / Tue Jun 29 5:00am BST

I also included a short agenda (attached) and the high-level deck. If you'd prefer a Calendly link to pick a slot that automatically rotates, here's my schedule: https://calendly.com/camila-reyes/redwood-demo

Attachments: Redwood_Overview_Deck.pdf, Tech_Deep_Dive_Agenda.docx, rotating_slots_template.ics

Thanks — look forward to locking something in.

Best,
